description: The attestation challenge endpoints: the authorization server's (POST /federation/attestation-challenge, ABCA-10 §6.1) and the attester's (GET /federation/attestation/challenge, CAS §4.1), each issuing into its own store. A challenge is issued, or refused before one is made. The challenge value is never an event field.

surface.description: Which endpoint answered: AS, the authorization server's, or CAS, the attester's.

attestation.challenge.issued.description: A challenge endpoint issued a challenge and recorded it in its surface's store.

attestation.challenge.refused.description: A challenge endpoint issued nothing: rate_limited (the caller's cap, 429 slow_down), store_unavailable (the store could not record it, 503) or method_not_allowed (another method than the endpoint's one, 405).
